revisionDesc.change: Finalized - Ready. I believe that L. Berkes is correct to suppose an abbreviation stroke rather than my suggestion of the vertical of an Ypsilon.
Vote - AcceptText - See Cowey's. As for line 4, it seems that after the kappa there might have been an abbreviation stroke (there is a speck), I don't think there is enough space for -ou.

Vote - AcceptText - lin4 instead of {[Θηβαι]κ[οῦ] λιμ[ί]τ̣ου} I would prefer {[Θηβαι]κ[ο]ῦ̣ λιμ[ί]τ̣ου} because after the large Kappa (large upper sections are visible) there is a lot of space before the Lambda. I feel sure of the trace of a vertical stroke which I take to be part of the Ypsilon. Otherwise fine.

Z. 4: [παρὰ ]κ̣ ̣ ̣μ ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ → {[Θηβαι]κ[οῦ] λιμ[ί]τ̣ου} πα̣ρ̣(ὰ) (nach der Abbildung leicht modifizierte Anpassung an BL VIII 53, wo {[Θηβαι]κοῦ λιμίτου} π(αρὰ) vorgeschlagen wurde. Das Rho von πα̣ρ̣(ὰ) ist zum Zeichen der Abkürzung schräg durchstrichen, vgl. z.B. SB IV 7369,4, abgebildet unter <http://www.papyrology.uw.edu.pl/papyri/pberlin13919r.jpg>). Ἀπίας → Ταπίας (Anpassung an R. Ast in Tyche 24 (2009) 215). Z. 11: χρη[τηρ]ίοις → χρησ[τηρ]ίοις (Eingabefehler). Z. 15: ἑνὸς → ἑνὸς (ἡμίσους) (Anpassung an BL VIII 53). Z. 16: [ταλάντων] → [μυριάδων] (Anpassung an K. A. Worp, ZPE 172 (2010) 168); π̣[εντ]ακοσίων φ̣ → π̣[εντ]ακοσίων (Eingabe- oder Konvertierungsfehler).
